sequence.title: Sequence Diagram
sequence.mermaid:
sequenceDiagram
  participant Boot as STM32 startup
  participant App as app_start
  participant I2C as I2C1 shared bus
  participant MPU as MPU6050
  participant DHT as DHT22 on PB4
  participant Timer as TIM3 edge timer
  participant Climate as climate_service
  participant Motion as motion_service
  participant Log as logger and USART2 console

  Boot->>App: call app_start
  App->>I2C: initialize bus and scan addresses
  I2C->>MPU: probe device and read WHO_AM_I
  MPU-->>App: scan and identity results
  App->>Motion: initialize motion service and MPU6050
  Motion->>I2C: configure sensor registers
  App->>Climate: initialize climate port
  Climate->>Timer: configure and start 1 MHz timing counter
  App->>Log: log startup status

  loop app poll with 1 ms idle delay
    App->>Motion: motion_service_poll
    alt motion sample is due
      Motion->>I2C: read acceleration register burst
      I2C->>MPU: fetch sensor registers
      MPU-->>Motion: raw acceleration axes
      alt calibration or valid processed sample
        Motion-->>App: reading and pending event state
        App->>Log: report due motion telemetry
        opt event is pending
          App->>Log: log event and acknowledge it
        end
      else acquisition failure
        Motion-->>App: error status
        App->>Log: log failure and stop polling
      end
    else motion sample is not due
      Motion-->>App: NOT_DUE
    end

    App->>Climate: climate_service_poll
    alt climate sample is due
      Climate->>DHT: initiate PB4 one-wire read
      Climate->>Timer: time response and data pulses
      DHT-->>Climate: 40-bit frame on PB4
      alt frame validates
        Climate-->>App: temperature and humidity reading
        App->>Log: report climate telemetry
      else read or validation error
        Climate-->>App: climate error status
        App->>Log: log unavailable climate reading
      end
    else climate sample is not due
      Climate-->>App: NOT_DUE
    end
  end
